out.explanation: Page 369 classifies both fund-based borrowings (88.85 million) and non-fund-based limits (410.63 million) under 'Total Secured Loans' (aggregating to 499.48 million), whereas Page 364 lists non-fund-based borrowings separately alongside fund-based borrowings and unsecured loans, creating an inconsistent presentation of what constitutes secured versus unsecured borrowings.
